legalDomain.conditionalEmission: The artifact exists per view only when judged applyEvents are nonEmpty; multi is one file per view with multiple event functions (not one file per event). Single-project base is 0 files. The writer consumes the view-keyed model; the template package is the projection package plus .handlers and the object name is the view name plus ApplyEvent — never doubled.
legalDomain.judgedInput: The generator consumes already-judged applyEvents: per event {eventName, eventFqn, applyForm in {create, updateOnly, delete, persistenceIdCreate}, bodyExpr final form (e./row/existing/emptyRow/ts/strOr/upsertBy references), deletePairs (exactly two for delete), viewColumns (column, typeSignature) with original resolved signatures}. Empty/???/unknown-dialect events (raw degraded) never reach the target file; the shell handler owns their absence.
legalDomain.importFace: First import is the configured business-base table view import <base>.application.projection.repository.<View>Table.<View> — the raw hardcoded net.imadz.metarch prefix is an explicit correction, never emitted. Then event imports: nonempty eventFqn, distinct, first-occurrence order (unsorted, pinned by property). Kernel files carry zero java.* import statements; java.time.Instant and net.imadz.common.Id appear fully qualified.
legalDomain.functionForms: create: def on<E>(existing: Option[View], e: E): View = existing.getOrElse(emptyRow).copy(...). updateOnly: def on<E>(row: View, e: E): View = row.copy(...) (empty judged body renders row). delete: def on<E>(e: E): (String, String) = (key0, key1) from the two judged deletePairs, positional 0/1. persistenceIdCreate: def on<E>(e: E, entityId: String): View = emptyRow(entityId, ...).copy(...). One doc line per function: '<E> -> <View>（referenceCode 直译·方言 <form>）'. Functions follow judged order; no dedup of duplicate event names exists because the input contract rejects duplicates.
legalDomain.helperRules: Helpers are emitted in fixed order emptyRow, ts, strOr, upsertBy, each only when triggered: emptyRow when a create-form body needs the row base and every create-form viewColumn default is derivable (defaultOf eight-type table: String/'' → \"\", Option → None, List/Seq → Nil, Id → net.imadz.common.Id.of zero-UUID, Boolean → false, Int/Long → 0; bare Instant and VO columns are NOT derivable and are rejected fail-closed at input validation instead of raw's existing.getOrElse(???) degradation); ts when a body contains ts(e. (epoch0/null → now — the family's single sanctioned clock read, never replaced by a time constant at this stage); strOr when a body contains strOr(; upsertBy when a body contains upsertBy(.
legalDomain.emptyRowForms: Plain (no persistenceId identityScheme): private def emptyRow: View = View(namedArgs) — Id columns zero-UUID, keyword columns backticked (eight-keyword set). persistenceId identityScheme: private def emptyRow(entityId: String, tenantId: String): View — every Id column takes net.imadz.common.Id.of(entityId), the tenantId column takes the parameter, the rest literal defaults (Park 判例). A persistenceId view never carries a plain create-form event: the parameterized helper has no existing in scope — the raw mixed-shape compile defect is prevented fail-closed at input validation.
legalDomain.kernelZeroMechanism: The object carries no annotations, inheritance, self-type or constructors; no Await, no repository call, no ActorRef, no PB, no ViewMachine reference, no MANUAL zone (this family is fully generated kernel, unlike the connector implementation family), no ??? — pinned as structural properties. PO unpacking and IO belong to the glue shell ViewMachine.run/updateOnly (projection-handler family owner).
legalDomain.supplyContract: Supplied files are handwritten nominal classes per the traditional contract and never emitted by the generator: the reservation entity events as a sealed ReservationEvent family (domain; CreditBalanceEntity precedent), the two Table objects with view case classes and column inventories (shell repository contract), and the trimmed net.imadz.common.Id common supply (alias + deterministic of; random face excluded).
legalDomain.layout: Emission holds a 100-column discipline: emptyRow and copy argument lists render one named argument per line (opening paren on the def or body-head line when it fits, closing paren at the statement indent); def parameter lists wrap one parameter per line over the limit; imports are exempt; no non-import app line exceeds 100 characters (structural property). Event functions carry one doc line; helpers carry one doc line each; the object doc is two lines.

events.body: existing.getOrElse(emptyRow).copy(skuId = e.skuId, label = strOr(e.label), quantity = e.quantity, reserved = true, lastEventAt = ts(e.occurredAt), `type` = "reserved", tenantId = e.tenantId)
row.copy(reserved = false, settledAt = Some(e.occurredAt), lastEventAt = ts(e.occurredAt))
row.copy(reserved = true, settledAt = None, lastEventAt = ts(e.occurredAt))

decisions.choice: CANDIDATE RULING for walkthrough ratification: the judged input contract is fail-closed — only executable events with applyForm in {create, updateOnly, delete, persistenceIdCreate} reach the file; empty/???/unknown forms (raw degraded) are rejected at validation, so no degraded function (existing.getOrElse(???) or bare-unknown arm) is ever emitted and no degraded-only imports/empty-object file exists; delete requires exactly two judged pairs (raw's positional fill of missing keys with \"\" becomes unreachable); duplicate event names are rejected; a persistenceId view rejects plain create-form events (the raw mixed-shape nonexistent-existing compile defect cannot be produced); bare-Instant and non-derivable viewColumns are rejected instead of raw's silent default-row omission. The raw deletePairs capture limitation (only key = e.field, no literal keys, position-only retrieval) is documented raw-only: judged pairs carry names and final expressions.

CANDIDATE RULING for walkthrough ratification: None patch semantics = the column is cleared (raw direct-take behavior kept and documented; the raw comment claiming columns are never overwritten is corrected); epoch0/null timestamps normalize to now inside ts (the family's single sanctioned clock read — explicitly NOT replaced by a time constant at this stage, with the structural property confining Instant.now to ts alone); emptyRow defaults are exactly the eight-type table; persistenceId identity columns all take entityId (Park 判例) and never fall back to the zero UUID (directed negative). Business-oracle properties pin each: create/updateOnly/persistenceIdCreate oracle equality, upsert slot discipline, delete key strings, ts pass-through and non-epoch0 normalization.

CANDIDATE RULING for walkthrough ratification: the first import uses the configured business base (example.stockreservation.application.projection.repository.<View>Table.<View>) — the raw hardcoded net.imadz.metarch prefix is an explicit correction, never emitted; kernel zero-mechanism is pinned structurally (no Await/ViewMachine reference/ActorRef/PB/SQL/MANUAL zone/???); the shell ViewMachine contract stays out of this sample (projection-handler family owner) and no common-core JAR claim is fabricated; viewColumns carry the original resolved signature (raw's nullable-Option divergence is not auto-repaired here — judged signatures are emitted verbatim and validated against the derivable-default table).

CANDIDATE RULING for walkthrough ratification: the shared quality engine derives this family's byte from the approved connector-family engine (f5c66788 core) with a boundary-only, property-pinned delta: (1) term names Instant and UUID are admitted at the boundary as the declared projection time/identity face — Random, Clock, LocalDateTime, Date, Await stay banned and the clock read is confined to ts by structural property; (2) the Term.Assign mutable-state violation fires in domain mode only because scalameta parses named arguments as Term.Assign and named arguments are the family's emptyRow/copy emission idiom — Defn.Var stays banned in both layers so no assignment target can exist at the boundary; (3) the target helper signature corrects raw's A => Any upsert key to A => String (Any is banned in both layers and the raw limitation is documented as such). Core measurement logic (ownDecisions/control/declaredScopes/forbidden/isDeclaration) is unchanged; meta-properties pin every delta arm.

Pure case-class files register zero measured scopes, which the gate requires nonempty: Table objects carry their column inventory (the viewColumns concept's home) as a val, and the entity events carry constructor require guards per the established curated domain discipline. The net.imadz.common supply is classified boundary (production shared common, trimmed to the consumed surface).

CANDIDATE RULING for walkthrough ratification: the target emission layout holds a 100-column discipline — emptyRow and copy argument lists always render one named argument per line (opening call paren stays on the def or body-head line when it fits, closing paren at the statement indent), def parameter lists wrap one parameter per line when the single line would exceed 100 columns, imports are exempt, and no non-import line in app sources may exceed 100 characters (pinned as a structural property). This replaces the raw template's single-line argument emission, which the first draft carried over and the walkthrough rejected as outside industry norms.

CANDIDATE RULING for walkthrough ratification: the nominal event supply follows the real-source entity idiom (CreditBalanceEntity precedent): a sealed ReservationEvent family inside the entity object with every event extending it. The sealed trait is a supply-fidelity fix only — the projection-apply-event family does not EMIT event types; it imports them by eventFqn (diff section 2: eventFqn is the entity event FQN; section 6 lists entity events as consumed glue types). Event-type emission belongs to the entity-side family.
